quality.timezone: America/New_York assumed from utility service area; CSV has no UTC offset

tariff_note: Standardized 2026 delivery schedule replay on Oct 2025 to Sep 2026 readings with fixed September 2026 base PSC $0.139822/kWh. Energy and service subtotal only. Taxes, adjustments, eligibility and actual billing-cycle tier proration excluded. Not historical alternative bills.

weather.note: Cooling association above 65 F with weekday controls; not appliance metering or a causal AC saving. Weather is ERA5 reanalysis at approximate town center.

forecast.note: Chronological selection and untouched final 28-day evaluation. Future multiday predictions are recursive. Daily bands resample seven-day residual blocks; seven-day total bounds use chronological cumulative errors whose calibration targets end before the holdout. Origins overlap and are not independent. The 28-day holdout admits only one complete 28-day forecast per model. Partial final day is excluded.

shapes.note: Three descriptive k-means groups on normalized complete-day shapes. Cluster labels do not identify occupancy or appliances.
